notes: The Budget KVM Sale lists 44 location-specific plans, 22 at USD 25.00 a year (4096 MB RAM, 2 cores, 35 GB of disk, 4 TB of transfer, a 10 Gbps port, 1 IPv4 and IPv6, 1 free snapshot) and 22 at USD 45.00 a year (8192 MB, 4 cores, 60 GB, 8 TB), and the Singapore, Tokyo and Hong Kong cards carry 750 GB or 1500 GB instead of 4 TB or 8 TB. Stock is the gate: eight of the 44 cards carry units and the other 36 read 0 Available. Every card reads "No refund/Money back on this plan", and no renewal rate is printed.

benchmark.note: EPYC 7702P at 2.00 GHz. Cheapest 4 vCPU row and the best multi-core per dollar among rows whose price matches the measured plan.

extras.refund: 7 days on a first VPS; promos, crypto and over-10%-bandwidth excluded, and every sale SKU order page says "No refund/Money back on this plan"
extras.renewal_note: not published: every card prices its rung annually and the page prints no renewal or recurring rate, and the terms state only that listed prices apply to new orders and that the vendor may adjust prices at the start of a billing cycle.
extras.stock: four 4 GiB cards carry stock on 2026-11-04 (BudgetKVMJAX-2 10 Available, BudgetKVMIL2-2 8 Available, BudgetKVMMO-2 8 Available, BudgetKVMRO-2 8 Available) and four 8 GiB cards do; the other 36 of the 44 cards read 0 Available
extras.cart_works: no: the product route answered HTTP 403 to a live read, and the archived copy of the plan page from 2026-10-25 rendered Out of Stock with orders suspended
